title: Phase 4 PILOT (underpowered): is there signal worth eight days of quota?

split.WARNING: test items come from the CALIBRATION pool; this is NOT the preregistered held-out split

metric: mean fraction correct per episode; paired difference vs the calibration-frozen best fixed policy, 95% CI from a cluster bootstrap over ITEMS (episodes are not independent here)
notes: PILOT. Underpowered by construction and recorded as such. The preregistered E0002 needs 420 items; Groq allows about 54/day.
